hero.heading: Slow coffee, made with care.
hero.subheading: We roast in small batches and brew with patience — so every cup tastes the way the farmer intended.

features.title: Single-origin beans
features.body: Sourced directly from growers in Ethiopia, Colombia and Guatemala — traceable to the farm.

features.title: Roasted this week
features.body: Every bag leaves our roastery within seven days of roasting, at peak flavour.

features.title: Made by hand
features.body: Our baristas pull every shot to order — no autopilot, no shortcuts.

items.name: Espresso
items.description: A clean double shot of our house blend.

items.name: Cortado
items.description: Equal parts espresso and warm milk.

items.name: Cold brew
items.description: Steeped 18 hours for a soft, chocolatey finish.

items.name: Iced latte
items.description: Double shot poured over cold milk and ice.

items.name: Banana bread
items.description: Brown butter, walnuts, a hint of cardamom.

story.heading: Our story
story.body: Monthicha’s cafe started in 2018 as a single roaster in a garage. Today we run a café and roastery from a converted timber yard, but the idea hasn't changed — buy great green coffee, roast it carefully, and serve it to people we know by name.

footer.tagline: Roasted in Brooklyn. Brewed with love.
